title: 第68章 老板娘，黄韵的小心思
content_zh:
第68章 老板娘，黄韵的小心思-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“滚开，滚开！”

黄韵脸上满是怒色和无力，不断伸手抽打刀疤的手，阻止咸猪手触碰到自己。

“嘭！”

就在刀疤享受其中的时候，突然感觉腰间一痛，整个人都被一股巨大力量踹飞了出去。

身子重重落在地上，惊起一地灰尘。

紧接着。

便传来阵阵痛苦哀嚎声。

“小子，你你敢……！”

另外两个小混混见状，伸手指着李青山就准备动手，却不曾想李青山率先动手，一个直踢，其中一名二流子被李青山踹中胸口，直接踹飞出去。

抓住另外一个二流子的胳膊，一个过肩摔！！

“嘭！”

又是一道沉闷声响起，三道痛苦哀嚎声在周围交叉响起。

李青山则是拍了拍手道：“打架还这么多废话！”

“小子，你敢偷袭？”

地上躺着的三个二流子捂着疼痛的地方站起身来，一脸凶狠的指着李青山道。

“来！”

李青山朝着刀疤招了招手道。

周围买猪肉的顾客则是纷纷张大了嘴巴，脸上满是震惊和诧异之色。

万万没想到，这后生的身手竟然这么好？

这三个二流子在附近打架可是出了名的，结果遇到这后生，踹飞两个，一个过肩摔又干掉一个。

真猛啊！！

怪不得能打到野猪呢。

被李青山挡在身后的早餐店老板娘黄韵，望着眼前这一幕，神情有些恍惚。

不知为何，原本烦乱畏惧的心，突然踏实了起来，好像找到了主心骨一般，紧紧躲在李青山身后，第一次感受到了什么叫男人带来的安全感。

“娘的，我攮死你！”

刀疤脸怒斥一声，手中拎着一把刀子便直接朝着李青山扎了过来，这是打红了眼。

“啊……！”

周围顾客惊叫一声，有些女人连忙闭上眼睛，躲在李青山身后的黄韵也不是看不到那刀子，顿时被吓得面色煞白。

这是打算玩命了。

这个年月，人命就跟地上的烂树叶子一样，不值钱，直到后面严打几次后才好起来。

“娘的，你是今天第二个跟老子玩刀子的了。”

李青山心中升起一抹无名怒火，望着朝自己刺来的刀子，根本就没有放在眼里，因为这刀疤脸的速度太慢了。

身子一闪躲，一只手抓住了刀疤脸的刀子。

Chapter 68 The boss lady, Huang Yun’s little thoughts - "Catching the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

"Go away, go away!"

Huang Yun's face was full of anger and weakness, and she kept reaching out to slap Dao Scar's hand to prevent the dirty hands from touching her.

"Bang!"

Just when Scar was enjoying it, he suddenly felt a pain in his waist, and his whole body was kicked away by a huge force.

The body fell heavily to the ground, stirring up dust all over the ground.

Immediately afterwards.

There were bursts of painful wails.

"Boy, how dare you...!"

Seeing this, the other two gangsters pointed at Li Qingshan and were ready to take action. However, they did not expect that Li Qingshan would take the lead and kick him. One of the thugs was kicked in the chest by Li Qingshan and flew away.

Grab the arm of another second-rate guy and throw him over his shoulder!!

"Bang!"

Another dull sound sounded, and three painful wails crisscrossed the surroundings.

Li Qingshan clapped his hands and said: "There is so much nonsense in the fight!"

"Boy, do you dare to make a sneak attack?"

The three fools lying on the ground stood up holding the painful area and pointed at Li Qingshan with fierce expressions.

"Come!"

Li Qingshan waved towards Scar.

The surrounding customers who were buying pork opened their mouths, their faces full of shock and surprise.

I never expected that this young man’s skills would be so good?

These three losers were famous for fighting in the neighborhood, but when they met this young man, they kicked two of them, threw one over his shoulder, and killed another one.

So fierce!!

No wonder we were able to hunt wild boars.

Huang Yun, the proprietress of the breakfast shop who was blocked by Li Qingshan, looked at the scene in front of her with a dazed expression.

For some reason, the originally troubled and fearful heart suddenly became at ease, as if it had found its backbone, and it hid tightly behind Li Qingshan. For the first time, it felt like the sense of security brought by a man.

"Mom, I will crush you to death!"

Scarface scolded angrily, holding a knife in his hand and stabbing Li Qingshan directly, which made him red-eyed.

"Ah...!"

The surrounding customers screamed in surprise, and some women quickly closed their eyes. Huang Yun, who was hiding behind Li Qingshan, could not fail to see the knife, and her face turned pale with fright.

This is about risking your life.

In this day and age, human life is as worthless as rotten tree leaves on the ground, and it will not get better until several severe beatings later.

"Mom, you are the second person to play with knives with me today."

A trace of unknown anger arose in Li Qingshan's heart. He looked at the knife stabbing him and didn't take it seriously at all, because the speed of the scar-faced knife was too slow.

He ducked and grabbed Scarface's knife with one hand.
